===== ai-comfyui.service =====
[Unit]
Description=ComfyUI (AI Portal)
After=network.target

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/home/cortana/ai/config/ai-env.env
EnvironmentFile=/home/cortana/ai/config/comfyui.env
ExecStart=/home/cortana/ai/bin/ai-comfyui.sh
WorkingDirectory=/home/cortana/ai/comfyui
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

===== ai-comfyui wrapper (/home/cortana/ai/bin/ai-comfyui.sh) =====
#!/bin/sh
# AI portal - ComfyUI launch wrapper (GENERATED, do not hand-edit).
# All parameters come from ~/ai/config/comfyui.env; change them via the
# portal's Settings page, then restart ai-comfyui.
set -eu
if [ ! -x "${COMFY_PYTHON:-}" ]; then
  echo "ai-comfyui: no python at ${COMFY_PYTHON:-<unset>}" >&2
  exit 1
fi
exec "$COMFY_PYTHON" "$COMFY_MAIN" --listen "$COMFY_HOST" --port "$COMFY_PORT" $COMFY_ARGS

===== ai-llama-router.service =====
[Unit]
Description=llama.cpp model router (AI Portal)
After=network.target

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/home/cortana/ai/config/ai-env.env
EnvironmentFile=/home/cortana/ai/config/llamacpp.env
ExecStart=/home/cortana/ai/bin/ai-llamacpp.sh
WorkingDirectory=/home/cortana/ai
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

===== ai-llama-router wrapper (/home/cortana/ai/bin/ai-llamacpp.sh) =====
#!/bin/sh
# AI portal - llama.cpp router launch wrapper (GENERATED, do not hand-edit).
# Every parameter comes from ~/ai/config/llamacpp.env; edit it via the portal's
# Settings page, then restart ai-llama-router to apply. The defaults below are
# only a safety net — the env file is what the portal writes and owns.
set -eu

LLAMA_BIN="${LLAMA_BIN:-/home/cortana/ai/bin/llama-server}"
if [ ! -x "$LLAMA_BIN" ]; then
  echo "ai-llama-router: no executable at $LLAMA_BIN (deploy a release first)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

set -- --host "${LLAMA_HOST:-127.0.0.1}" --port "${LLAMA_PORT:-8080}"
if [ "${LLAMA_METRICS:-1}" = "1" ]; then set -- "$@" --metrics; fi
if [ -n "${LLAMA_API_KEY_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${LLAMA_API_KEY_FILE}" ]; then
  set -- "$@" --api-key-file "${LLAMA_API_KEY_FILE}"
fi
set -- "$@" --models-max "${LLAMA_MODELS_MAX:-1}" \
           --models-dir "${LLAMA_MODELS_DIR:-/home/cortana/ai/models/llama}" \
           --models-preset "${LLAMA_PRESETS:-/home/cortana/ai/config/llama/presets.ini}"
# free-form extra args: intentionally word-split (no quoting supported)
for a in ${LLAMA_ARGS:-}; do set -- "$@" "$a"; done

# AI_PORTAL_PRINT_ARGV=1 prints the argv instead of exec'ing llama-server: the
# portal uses it to verify a launch config without loading a model.
if [ "${AI_PORTAL_PRINT_ARGV:-0}" = "1" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' "$LLAMA_BIN" "$@"
  exit 0
fi
exec "$LLAMA_BIN" "$@"

===== ai-portal.service =====
[Unit]
Description=AI Tool Management Portal (web console)
After=network.target

[Service]
EnvironmentFile=/home/cortana/ai/config/ai-env.env
EnvironmentFile=/home/cortana/ai/config/portal.env
ExecStart=/home/cortana/ai/bin/ai-portal.sh
WorkingDirectory=/home/cortana/ai/ai-portal
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

===== ai-portal wrapper (/home/cortana/ai/bin/ai-portal.sh) =====
#!/bin/sh
# AI portal - portal launch wrapper (GENERATED, do not hand-edit).
# Parameters come from ~/ai/config/portal.env; edit via the Settings page or
# `python -m app.deploy`, then restart ai-portal.
set -eu
DIR="${AI_PORTAL_DIR:-/home/cortana/ai/ai-portal}"
PY="${AI_PORTAL_PYTHON:-/usr/bin/python3}"
if [ ! -x "$PY" ]; then
  echo "ai-portal: no python at $PY (run: python -m app.deploy)" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$DIR/app/main.py" ]; then
  echo "ai-portal: no app tree at $DIR" >&2
  exit 1
fi
cd "$DIR"
exec "$PY" -m uvicorn app.main:app \
  --host "${AI_PORTAL_HOST:-0.0.0.0}" \
  --port "${AI_PORTAL_PORT:-8090}" \
  --log-level "${AI_PORTAL_UVICORN_LOG_LEVEL:-warning}"
